modules.responsibility: 输入边界及输出媒体类型
高程格网、相邻面和三角插值
湿面标注、入水点定位、连通分量与积水环
制图编辑、预览、图面取点和下载

workflows.name: 格网与三角化
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {compose} from "./server/sheet/compose.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/terrain/demo.mjs"; const a=compose({grid:demo()}); if(a.faces<=0||a.faces>=2*27*21)process.exit(1); console.log(a.faces);'
steps: 从 POST sheet 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，形成有效三角面

workflows.name: 等值线提取
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {compose} from "./server/sheet/compose.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/terrain/demo.mjs"; const a=compose({grid:{width:2,height:2,unit:1,elevations:[0,10,10,20]},interval:5}); if(!a.levels.some(x=>x.height===10&&x.paths===1))process.exit(1); console.log(a.levels);'
steps: 从 POST sheet 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，同级交点拼成路径

workflows.name: 选幅裁线
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {compose} from "./server/sheet/compose.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/terrain/demo.mjs"; const a=compose({grid:demo(),bounds:{left:40,bottom:40,right:450,top:370}}); if(!a.svg.includes('"'"'viewBox="0 0 410 330"'"'"'))process.exit(1); console.log(a.bounds);'
steps: 从 POST sheet 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，输出限制在图幅的线

workflows.name: 测线剖面
workflows.success: 测点按真实里程排列并报告缺测
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {compose} from "./server/sheet/compose.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/terrain/demo.mjs"; const a=compose({grid:demo(),section:{x1:0,y1:140,x2:540,y2:140,count:61}}); if(a.profile.length!==61||!a.profile.some(p=>p.z===null)||a.profile.at(-1).distance!==540)process.exit(1); console.log(a.section.length);'
steps: 从 POST sheet 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，测点按真实里程排列并报告缺测

workflows.name: 矢量图导出
workflows.success: 可重复产出同样的 SVG
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {compose} from "./server/sheet/compose.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/terrain/demo.mjs"; const data={grid:demo()}; const a=compose(data); if(!a.svg.includes("data-elevation")||a.svg!==compose(data).svg)process.exit(1); console.log(a.svg.length);'
steps: 从 POST export 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，可重复产出同样的 SVG

workflows.name: 积水连通分析
workflows.success: 标注入水位置在给定水位可达的整片低地并叠加到图幅
workflows.failure: 山脊、缺测区、顶角接触、水位平齐窄坎不接通，无效起点拒绝
steps: 在全格网三角网上标注湿面并按共享边求连通分量
定位入水位置并拒绝缺测、旱地、水位平齐和顶点歧义点
合并湿面截多边形为积水环，按选幅裁剪后叠加到 SVG

mechanisms: 湿面连通分量与入水点歧义判定
积水环合并与图面取点留白校正
